question.text: Under Section 51A of UAPA, which of the following is NOT a power granted to the Central Government?

answer.text: Granting bail to individuals suspected of terrorism without court approval
Freezing, seizing or attaching funds and other financial assets held by listed individuals or entities
Prohibiting anyone from making funds or related services available to listed individuals or entities
Preventing entry into or transit through India of individuals listed in the Schedule

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook lists three specific Section 51A powers of the Central Government: (1) freeze, seize or attach funds and other financial assets/economic resources of listed individuals or entities, (2) prohibit anyone from making funds, financial assets, or related services available to such listed persons, and (3) prevent entry into or transit through India of such listed individuals. Granting bail is not among those three powers. The Trap: The three real powers are placed as distractors. The correct answer is the one item that the workbook does not list under Section 51A. Note: Stay strictly within the three powers identified under Section 51A; do not assume any wider executive authority on the basis of context outside the workbook.
